name: Koios.News is a MetroPlat instance that meets then beats every other news site
asks: Koios.News: "meet then beat every other news site in the world" (2026-10-02); "Koios.News is meant to be a MetroPlat instance" (2026-09-28); fix it aggressively yourself (2026-10-02, 2026-10-03); retire experimental.koios.news (2026-10-03). Full words by address in provenance.

x-provenance.recorded-by: koios-news pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: Koios.News publishes routinely as a MetroPlat instance, meets and then beats every other news site.

requirements.says: The Koios.News property shall be a MetroPlat instance served by FeltOS.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-28: "Koios.News is meant to be a MetroPlat instance."

requirements.says: The Koios.News line shall publish articles on a routine cadence across its desks.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-28: "it doesn't even post articles routinely".

requirements.says: The Koios.News line shall meet and then beat gazetteview.com, then the Guardian, then every other news site, as measured by the instruments of the 2026-10-02 note on the Koios news line.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-02: meet then beat gazetteview.com and the Guardian, and "every other news site in the world".

requirements.says: Every builder of the Koios.News property shall build from the property record's declared inputs, including the claim store, so that a scratch build equals the production build.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-03: commit deec8b7, scratch build matching production 5358 of 5358.

requirements.says: The release step shall build from the property inputs plus the already-published posts at release time, so that a release cannot fall behind production.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-03: the root fix over re-rendering the one edition.

requirements.says: The release step shall retire each release attempt's Cloudflare preview worker when the attempt ends.
The release step shall release the first accepted edition (Welsh devolution) from a build that contains claims/ and wire/.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-03: its rendered candidate predated the fix and was missing both.

requirements.says: The fold shall revise the SEC, Blast, Ethiopia and G7 stories and raise the published volume.
The release report shall state its result against the meet/beat strategy.
The property set shall exclude experimental.koios.news.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-03: experimental.koios.news is old dead weight.

requirements.says: Each part of the Koios.News property shall carry a plan, derived from the house's development paradigms and tooling, that reduces its bloat, its error and its latency.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-28: every part is bloated, stupid and slow; plan what things should be rather than patch bugs.

requirements.says: The Koios.News work procedure shall resolve each friction by the corporate-professional test.
The Koios.News work procedure shall permit concurrent agents in one part of the property.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-24: there is surely enough for both agents to work concurrently.

requirements.says: The Koios.News property shall publish about twelve to eighteen articles a day across its desks, set finally by market research.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-28: start at "1/2 the rate of the guardian per day, across all their various desks, so probably like 12-18 articles a day … But we should let market research decide this, ultimately."
